covenants.text: (a) Commencing with the Test Period ending on the last day of the first full fiscal quarter ended after the Fourth Amendment Effective Date, the Parent Borrower shall not permit the First Lien Net Leverage Ratio on the last day of each Test Period to be greater than 5.00 to 1.00 (the “ First Lien Net Leverage Ratio Financial Covenant ”);
